clue.text: Mother and son blasted French butcher

parts.note: MA is an everyday word for mother
sacré is the French word for damned or blasted

explanation.surface: A mother and her son curse a French butcher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butcher' looks like a noun for a French shopkeeper, but it is a verb meaning to slaughter.
explanation.definitionFit: To butcher people is to slaughter them brutally in large numbers, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Pasty perhaps? He is in an underground club!

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the words he is are placed in among the letters for an underground club

parts.note: a dive is a seedy basement bar or club
he is contracts to he's

explanation.surface: A man announces that he's down in a basement nightclub, perhaps a pasty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pasty' looks like the Cornish pie, but here it is the adjective meaning paste-like or sticky, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pasty has the sticky quality of paste, and glue-like substances are described the same way.

clue.text: Little Dafydd brings in line painter

indicators.note: the short Welsh name takes in the letter for line, so it is the container here

parts.note: Dai is the common Welsh pet form of Dafydd (David)

explanation.surface: A small Welshman brings a line of paint to a painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Salvador Dalí was the Spanish surrealist artist, so he is an example of a painter.

clue.text: Anti-fascist group in van

parts.note: to be in is to be fashionable or popular
the van, short for vanguard, is the front

explanation.surface: Members of an anti-fascist group ride in a van.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In van' reads as travelling in a vehicle, but each word is a synonym: in for fashionable, van for the leading part.
explanation.definitionFit: Popular fronts were 1930s coalitions of left-wing parties formed to oppose fascism.

clue.text: An ancient God embodies attendant spirit in city

indicators.note: the god's letters take in the spirit's, so embodying is containing

parts.note: taken as written
Ra was the Egyptian sun god
in Egyptian belief the ka is the spiritual double that accompanies a person

explanation.surface: An old god takes the form of a guardian spirit within a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Ankara is the capital city of Turkey, so it is an example of a city.

clue.text: Beast with new wife inspires good university pairing

parts.note: an ox is a beast of burden

indicators.note: to inspire is literally to breathe in, so the bride takes the letter inside

parts.note: a bride is a newly married woman

explanation.surface: An animal and a newly married woman inspire a good partnership between universities.
explanation.definitionFit: The word joins Oxford and Cambridge, the two ancient English universities, as a combined pair.

clue.text: Financial family in crash

indicators.note: the word for family sits inside the word for crash

parts.note: a bang is a loud crash
kin are one's family or relatives

explanation.surface: A family is ruined in a financial crash.
explanation.definitionFit: Banking is used attributively for the world of finance, as in banking sector or financial sector.

clue.text: Luggage taken in taxi back from Natalie Cole

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
a bag is a piece of luggage

indicators.note: the back of the name Natalie is its last letter

explanation.surface: Luggage taken into a taxi returns from the singer Natalie Cole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Natalie Cole' reads as the singer's name, but Natalie only gives its last letter and Cole stands alone as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Cole is an old word for brassicas such as kale and the common round-headed green vegetable.

clue.text: True account shortened by junior minister

indicators.note: the abbreviation for account loses its final letter, so it is cut short

parts.note: a curate is an assistant to a parish priest, a junior minister of religion

explanation.surface: A truthful account is cut short by a junior government minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Junior minister' suggests a government post; here the minister is a clergyman. ACC shortened to AC.
explanation.definitionFit: Something accurate is correct or true, a direct adjectival synonym.

clue.text: Urban resident to admit severing link

indicators.note: the word for admit cuts the tie in two, so it goes inside

parts.note: a tie is a link or bond
to own (up to) something is to admit it

explanation.surface: A city dweller is willing to admit cutting a connection.
explanation.definitionFit: A townie is an informal word for someone who lives in a town rather than the country.

clue.text: Old-fashioned hardship reported in sailing vessel

parts.note: square is slang for conventional or old-fashioned

indicators.note: reported means the word is to be said out loud, sounding like another

parts.note: rigour can mean harshness or hardship

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned hardship is described on board a sailing ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A square-rigger is a ship rigged with square sails set across the hull, a type of sailing ship.

clue.text: Bits sourced as appropriate from old VDUs?

indicators.note: only the suitable letters are taken, here the odd-numbered ones of the words

explanation.surface: Computer parts salvaged from obsolete display units.
explanation.walkthrough: VDU is a visual display unit, an old computer monitor. Taking letters 1, 3, 5, 7 of OLDVDUS gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: As in odds and ends, the plural means miscellaneous small items or bits.

clue.text: Upset due to endless trouble one day before

indicators.note: the word for trouble loses its last letter

parts.note: aggro is British slang for trouble or aggression
I is the Roman numeral for one
the eve is the day before an event

explanation.surface: Someone is upset by constant trouble the day before something.
explanation.definitionFit: To aggrieve someone is to upset or distress them, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: After collapse, get spire standing

indicators.note: after the words fall down their letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Once it has collapsed, try to get the church spire standing again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standing' looks like the spire upright again, but it is a noun meaning status.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing as a noun means reputation or status, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Olympics venue welcomes a legendary runner

indicators.note: the venue takes in the article, as a host welcomes a guest

parts.note: Atlanta hosted the 1996 Summer Olympics

explanation.surface: An Olympic host city welcomes a famous athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the huntress was a swift runner who raced her suitors.

clue.text: Aunt giddy after dance with sailor gets fish

indicators.note: the jumbled aunt comes after the dance and the sailor

parts.note: to skip is to dance lightly
jack, as in jack tar, is a sailor

indicators.note: giddy means dizzy and whirling, so the letters spin into a new order

explanation.surface: An aunt is dizzy after dancing with a seaman, then gets some fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A skipjack tuna is a small striped species of tuna, an example of a fish.

clue.text: Tea taken by simple clergyman

parts.note: cha (char) is British slang for tea
plain means simple

explanation.surface: Tea is taken by an unpretentious priest.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaplain is a clergyman attached to an institution such as a school or regiment.

clue.text: Nobleman over there at point near start

parts.note: an earl is a British nobleman
yon is an old word for that place over there

explanation.surface: A nobleman over there stands at a point near the start.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at an early stage, soon after something begins.

clue.text: Church leader leaving Peru, bishop, finds winged child

indicators.note: the first letter of Peru departs

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A church leader leaves Peru with a bishop and finds a winged child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Church leader' wants to read as a head of a church, but Church gives CH and 'leader leaving' acts on Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherub is depicted in art as a chubby child with wings.

clue.text: Revolutionary element to fight it out

indicators.note: an element is a part of something, so the answer is a component of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A revolutionary faction wants to fight it out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Element' suggests a chemical element such as TI, but it signals letters lying within FIGHT IT OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Josip Broz Tito led the Yugoslav partisans and their communist revolution.

clue.text: Arrive and greet the assembly

indicators.note: an assembly puts parts together, so the letters are put together afresh

explanation.surface: Arrive and greet those gathered at the meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: To get there is an idiom for reaching a destination, which is to arrive.

clue.text: Artist in London E3 with grumpy woman spotted swimmer

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
taken as written
Bow is the East London district with the postcode E3
an old trout is a slang term for a bad-tempered woman

explanation.surface: An artist in East London is with an ill-tempered woman spotted swimming.
explanation.definitionFit: This freshwater fish has a spotted body with a pink stripe, so it is a speckled swimmer.

clue.text: Poor playwright saves rupees for rail timetable

indicators.note: the word for poor holds onto the letter, keeping it inside

parts.note: bad means poor in quality
George Bernard Shaw was the Irish playwright

explanation.surface: A penniless dramatist puts by some rupees for a railway timetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Bradshaw's Guide was the famous Victorian British book of railway timetables.

clue.text: Learner leaving road trapping cat that's crossed — it's a tragedy

indicators.note: the shortened road holds the cross-bred cat inside
the learner departs from the road

parts.note: a lane is a road
L is the learner-driver sign
a tigon is the hybrid offspring of a tiger and a lioness

explanation.surface: A learner driver leaves the road after trapping a crossing cat: a tragedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crossed' suggests the cat crossing the road; it means cross-bred. LANE less L leaves ANE.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Greek tragedy by Sophocles, an example of a tragic drama.

clue.text: Animal trained to look for an owner?

definitions.text: Animal trained to look for an owner?

parts.words: Animal trained to look for an owner?
parts.note: it seems to describe a pet seeking a home, but the animal looks on behalf of its blind owner

explanation.definitionFit: A guide dog is trained to see for a visually impaired person, doing their looking for them.

clue.text: Woman who's fallen a long way down crossing border from south

indicators.note: the word for far down stretches across the border, so it contains it

parts.note: deep means a long way down

indicators.note: in a down clue reading from the south is reading upwards

parts.note: a rim is a border or edge

explanation.surface: A woman has dropped a great distance while crossing the border from the south.
explanation.definitionFit: A demirep is an old word for a woman of doubtful reputation, a fallen woman.

clue.text: Russian exile unsettled after start in academia

indicators.note: the jumbled exile comes after the first letter
the start of academia is its first letter
unsettled means disturbed, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Russian exile is unsettled after starting in academia.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexei is a common Russian man's name, so it can stand for a Russian.

clue.text: Impulse to put gallon in Yorkshire river

indicators.note: the gallon goes in the river

parts.note: the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A sudden desire to pour a gallon into a Yorkshire river.
explanation.definitionFit: An urge is a strong impulse or desire, a direct synonym.
